layoutPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create the NEW ground-only terrain immediately EAST of the narrow neighboring terrain shown in image 1. Image 1 is the western NEIGHBOR, not part of the output; the output LEFT edge must join its RIGHT edge at identical heights. Image 2 is a surface style and scale reference for the destination courtyard. Output a 1536 by 1024 landscape planning plate representing 768 by 512 game world units, orthographic elevated isometric camera, no horizon. Along the LEFT edge match image 1: warm stone paving occupies the upper approximately 55 percent, a low green wedge and the stone bridge abutment occur around 56–66 percent height, turquoise canal water fills the lower 34 percent. Continue the existing stone bridge smoothly toward the RIGHT into a broad accessible paved parcel-courtyard in the center/right, not another bridge or disconnected island. Keep the canal only in the bottom-left quadrant: its curving stone bank descends to the bottom edge around 28 percent canvas width. The flat courtyard above/right has a broad public pedestrian route which connects to the bridge entrance at left around 62 percent canvas height, turns slightly upward to cross the center, and exits the RIGHT edge between 28 and 51 percent canvas height, to join the separate parcel-yard reference. The upper-left paved station platform blends into an upper garden lot, but all public walking routes remain on one level with no stair crossing. Add curved low curbs around small grassy building lots in the upper-right and lower-right. Keep several open areas for independently editable stalls, depot, benches, crates, trees. Paint cream/honey cobbles and small gray paving stones with consistent small scale, soft olive grass, granular soil, turquoise water, detailed hand-painted game art matching latest references. TERRAIN ONLY: no buildings, tall plants, trees, furniture, crates, lamps, boats, people, letters, signs, text, labels, grid, UI, border or cast shadows from absent objects. Geometry and roads must meet frame edges exactly as specified. Output only this NEW neighbor chunk. Do not copy the narrow reference strip into the output.
revisions: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix this terrain stitching mismatch. Image is a 1920 by 1024 terrain planning layout made from an EXISTING neighbor in the LEFTMOST 20 percent and a NEW east extension in the RIGHTMOST 80 percent. The original vertical join is at exactly 20 percent of image width. Preserve the LEFTMOST 20 percent exactly: those original cobbles, stairs, bridge approach, grass and canal must not move at all. Modify only the NEW east extension to form one continuous, physically sensible painted terrain with no visible vertical seam. At the join, the original stair's foot and bridge deck meet the new ground around 60–67 percent canvas height; EXTEND THAT EXISTING BRIDGE ROAD horizontally/rightward onto the new courtyard at the same height. Remove the new duplicate staircase/bridge abutment that currently floats too high just to the right of the join. Lower the new bridge/canal bank at its LEFT edge so both banks and road deck join the existing original precisely. Then smoothly curve the new bank toward the current lower-middle bank, keeping canal water below it. Continuous flat public route on the new side, no stairs across it. Match the original small paving-stone size across the seam; the new side's stones are currently too large, make them the same scale as the original. Keep the rest of the new courtyard's upper and lower grass lots and its broad RIGHT-edge road exits in their existing positions. Preserve the 1920:1024 rectangular composition and exact camera/zoom, no crop. Ground only. No trees, houses, objects, people, text, annotations or UI. Output the corrected entire composition at the same aspect ratio.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this ground terrain image. The translucent pink band and dashed white centerline are ONLY an editing guide: replace their exact corridor with a continuous walkable honey-stone ramp linking the existing lower bridge to the upper right-hand courtyard. Remove every bit of the pink/white annotation from the final. The ramp starts exactly at x384,y630 in this 1920x1024 layout, curves slightly right through x480,y640 then climbs diagonally northeast to x670,y475. It is 70–90 pixels wide. Cut an opening through the currently blocking low wall and grassy strip along that corridor. Replace only the blocking wall/grass inside the corridor with cobbled gently sloping ramp pavement, flanked by low curbs; no vertical wall or steps across the route. The bridge entrance at x384,y630 must remain connected to the ramp without a drop. Preserve ALL terrain in the LEFTMOST 20 percent (x0..383) exactly. Preserve all other water, bank, grass-lot and courtyard edges outside the small corridor. Keep the same camera, same paving stone size, same daytime colors, exact composition and 1920:1024 aspect. No objects, people, text, guide marks, UI or border. Output the full corrected image.
